Bump firing is a trick for firing a rifle faster.

You're basically pulling the gun forward with your left hand against your stationary trigger finger on the right hand. This depresses the trigger, discharging a round, which causes the gun to recoil backwards. At this point the trigger resets, and your left hand pulls the gun forward again, which fires a second shot. Balance the pressure of your left hand the right way, and the result is firing many shots very quickly, with very poor aim.
